name: Boss Punishment
source:
The story of the secret of the boss of the Wild Dogs gang. And about his nimble ward, who was able to expose the secret essence of his boss. And take full advantage of it.

[From [url=https://morlo.itch.io/boss-punishment]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕野狗帮老大的秘密，以及他手下一个机灵的小子展开。这个小子揭穿了老大隐藏的真面目，还把这个秘密利用得淋漓尽致。

[摘自[url=https://morlo.itch.io/boss-punishment]itch.io[/url]]
